ENCOURAGED by the extremely kind reception which has been awarded to my previous books, and by the assurances, which have reached me from the most unexpected sources, that they have been found pleasant and profitable, I am venturing to offer to the same indulgent public a third collection of personal studies of natural history.

arxiv-2203-01044.title: SelfKG: Self-Supervised Entity Alignment in Knowledge Graphs Conference: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2022; April 25–29, 2022; Virtual Event, Lyon, France. Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2022 (WWW ’22), April 25–29, 2022, Virtual Event, Lyon, France Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-9096
arxiv-2203-01044.creator: Xiao Liu † , Haoyun Hong † , Xinghao Wang † , Zeyi Chen † , Evgeny Kharlamov ‡ , Yuxiao Dong † , Jie Tang †
arxiv-2203-01044.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiao Liu † , Haoyun Hong † , Xinghao Wang † , Zeyi Chen † , Evgeny Kharlamov ‡ , Yuxiao Dong † , Jie Tang †. Entity alignment, aiming to identify equivalent entities across different knowledge graphs (KGs), is a fundamental problem for constructing Web-scale KGs. Over the course of its development, the label supervision has been considered necessary for accurate alignments.

arxiv-2205-12381.title: First Contact: Unsupervised Human-Machine Co-Adaptation via Mutual Information Maximization
arxiv-2205-12381.creator: Siddharth Reddy, Sergey Levine, Anca D. Dragan
arxiv-2205-12381.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Siddharth Reddy, Sergey Levine, Anca D. Dragan. How can we train an assistive human-machine interface (e.g., an electromyography-based limb prosthesis) to translate a user’s raw command signals into the actions of a robot or computer when there is no prior mapping, we cannot ask the user for supervision in the form of action labels or reward feedback, and we do not have prior knowledge of the tasks the user is trying to accomplish?

arxiv-2311-08713.title: Four-body bound states in momentum space: the Yakubovsky approach without two-body t − t- matrices
arxiv-2311-08713.creator: M. Mohammadzadeh, M. Radin, K. Mohseni, M. R. Hadizadeh
arxiv-2311-08713.description: Abstract This study presents a solution to the Yakubovsky equations for four-body bound states in momentum space, bypassing the common use of two-body t − t- matrices. Typically, such solutions are dependent on the fully-off-shell two-body t − t- matrices, which are obtained from the Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation for two-body subsystem energies controlled by the second and third Jacobi momenta.

arxiv-2402-15789.title: Stable Liftings of Polynomial Traces on Tetrahedra Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2402-15789.creator: Charles Parker, Endre Süli
arxiv-2402-15789.description: Abstract On the reference tetrahedron K K , we construct, for each k ∈ ℕ 0 k\in\mathbb{N}_{0} , a right inverse for the trace operator u ↦ ( u , ∂ 𝐧 u , … , ∂ 𝐧 k u ) | ∂ K u\mapsto(u,\partial_{\mathbf{n}}u,\ldots,\partial_{\mathbf{n}}^{k}u)|_{\partial K} .

arxiv-2403-10541.title: Bulk Viscosity, Speed of Sound and Contact Structure at Intermediate Coupling
arxiv-2403-10541.creator: Shivam Singh Kushwah, Aalok Misra
arxiv-2403-10541.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shivam Singh Kushwah, Aalok Misra. Thermal QCD systems like strongly coupled QGP require not only a large ’t-Hooft coupling but also a finite gauge coupling [ 1 ] in the large- N N gravity dual. Unlike almost all top-down holographic models in the literature, holographic large- N N thermal QCD models based on this assumption, therefore necessarily require addressing this limit from ℳ {\cal M} theory.

arxiv-2502-00553.title: The Influence of Stellar Chromospheres and Coronae on Exoplanet Transmission Spectroscopy
arxiv-2502-00553.creator: Volker Perdelwitz, Adam Chaikin-Lifshitz, Aviv Ofir, Oded Aharonson
arxiv-2502-00553.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Volker Perdelwitz, Adam Chaikin-Lifshitz, Aviv Ofir, Oded Aharonson. A main source of bias in transmission spectroscopy of exoplanet atmospheres is magnetic activity of the host star in the form of stellar spots, faculae or flares. However, the fact that main-sequence stars have a chromosphere and a corona, and that these optically thin layers are dominated by line emission may alter the global interpretation of the planetary spectrum, has largely been neglected.

arxiv-2507-02507.title: Design of a three-dimensional parallel-to-point imaging system based on inverse methods
arxiv-2507-02507.creator: Sanjana Verma, Lisa Kusch, Koondanibha Mitra, Martijn J.H. Anthonissen, Jan H.M. ten Thije Boonkkamp, Wilbert L. IJzerman
arxiv-2507-02507.description: Abstract We present an inverse method for designing a three-dimensional imaging system comprising of freeform optical surfaces. We impose an imaging condition on the optical map and combine it with the law of conservation of energy to conclude that the ratio of energy distributions at the source and target of an imaging system must be constant.

arxiv-2510-14809.description: Abstract Low- to intermediate-mass ( ∼ \sim 0.8 − - 8 M ⊙ ) evolved stars contribute significantly to the chemical enrichment of the interstellar medium in the local Universe. It is therefore crucial to accurately measure the mass return in their final evolutionary stages.

pmc-10596943.title: Long-term health consequences in persons with and without SARS-CoV-2 infection in Germany
pmc-10596943.creator: C Heidemann, G Sarganas, Y Du, B Gaertner, C Poethko-Müller, C Cohrdes, S Schmidt, M Schlaud, C Scheidt-Nave
pmc-10596943.description: BackgroundSo far, few population-based studies comprehensively examined health consequences of COVID-19 including a control group not exposed to SARS-CoV-2 infection and a long-term follow-up. This cohort study of 4817 adults from four municipalities in Germany examined health consequences among individuals more than one year after SARS-CoV-2 infection compared with non-infected individuals.

pmc-10632913.title: A Pragmatic Mapping of Perceptions and Use of Digital Information Systems in Primary Care in Sweden: Survey Study
pmc-10632913.creator: Anita Sant’Anna, Jens Nygren
pmc-10632913.description: BackgroundElectronic health records and IT infrastructure in primary care allow for digital documentation and access to information, which can be used to guide evidence-based care and monitor patient safety and quality of care. Quality indicators specified by regulatory authorities can be automatically computed and presented to primary care staff.

pmc-10648057.title: Evaluation of Self-Healing Properties of OPC-Slag Cement Immersed in Seawater Using UPV Measurements
pmc-10648057.creator: Choonghyun Kang, Yongmyung Park, Taewan Kim
pmc-10648057.description: In this study, OPC-slag cement, which partially replaced ground granulated blast-furnace slag (GGBFS), was immersed in seawater at three temperatures and the self-healing effect was evaluated through ultrasonic pulse velocity (UPV) measurement. In addition, test specimens without cracks were immersed and cured in the same seawater environment to compare the characteristics of UPV and crack-healing effects.

pmc-11457788.title: The Effect of Oral Care Intervention in Mucositis Management Among Pediatric Cancer Patients: An Updated Systematic Review [Response to Letter]
pmc-11457788.creator: Ikeu Nurhidayah, Nani Nurhaeni, Allenidekania Allenidekania, Dewi Gayatri, Henny Suzana Mediani
pmc-11457788.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Review ”1 Their insights are greatly appreciated and will help improve the topics surrounding our current study. We agree and are pleased to acknowledge the positive points they raised regarding the strengths of this study. Their identification of our research in reviewing oral care interventions for mucositis management in pediatric cancer patients followed a systematic method with in-depth collection and analysis.

pmc-11667741.title: Alternative Health and Conventional Medicine Discourse About Cancer on TikTok: Computer Vision Analysis of TikTok Videos
pmc-11667741.creator: Roxana Mika Muenster, Kai Gangi, Drew Margolin
pmc-11667741.description: BackgroundHealth misinformation is abundant online and becoming an increasingly pressing concern for both oncology practitioners and patients with cancer. On social media platforms, including the popular audiovisual app TikTok, the flourishing alternative health industry is further contributing to the spread of misleading and often harmful information, endangering patients’ health and outcomes and sowing distrust of the medical community.

pmc-12402194.title: Ayahuasca-assisted meaning reconstruction therapy as an early resource for bereavement: a non-randomized clinical trial
pmc-12402194.creator: Oscar Soto-Angona, Oscar Andión, Pablo Sabucedo, Robert A Neimeyer, Josep Maria Haro, Julia Javkin, Magí Farré, Débora González
pmc-12402194.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Preliminary evidence suggests that ayahuasca may alleviate severe grief symptoms. This three-arm, sequentially allocated, open-label study examines the therapeutic changes associated with ayahuasca-assisted meaning reconstruction therapy (A-MR) compared to meaning reconstruction therapy alone (MR) and a no-treatment control (NT). A total of 84 adults experiencing severe grief within 12 months of losing a first-degree relative were allocated to A-MR (n = 28), MR (n = 28), or NT (n = 28).

pmc-12525734.title: Highly Selective Isotropic Etching of Si to SiGe Using CF4/O2/N2 Plasma for Advanced GAA Nanosheet Transistor
pmc-12525734.creator: Jiayang Li, Xin Sun, Ziqiang Huang, David Wei Zhang
pmc-12525734.description: The paradigm shift from FinFET to gate-all-around nanosheet (GAA-NS) transistor architectures necessitates fundamental innovations in channel material engineering. This work addresses the critical challenge of pFET performance degradation in GAA-NS technologies through the development of an advanced selective etching process for strain-engineered SiGe channel formation.

pmc-12589400.title: Association between triglyceride glucose index trajectory and risk of hypertension in rural residents: a prospective cohort study
pmc-12589400.creator: Bahegu Yimingniyazi, Tingting Qiao, Duolao Wang, Lei Chu, Tao Luo, Yuanshen Gu, Anaer Gaoshao, Runze Ma, Dapeng Lin, Jiangtao Zhang, Jianghong Dai, Demin Han
pmc-12589400.description: With changes in lifestyle, the incidence of hypertension in rural areas is on the rise. However, previous studies have not investigated the association between TyG index trajectories and the risk of hypertension in rural populations, particularly in multi-center natural population cohorts. Our study aimed to examine the association between TyG index trajectories and hypertension risk in rural populations.

pmc-12621766.title: Predictive value of aortoiliac calcification of deceased donors for chronicity score of allograft baseline biopsies and graft outcomes in kidney transplantation: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12621766.creator: Young Ju Oh, Jongmin Sim, Heungman Jun, Myung-Gyu Kim, Cheol Woong Jung
pmc-12621766.description: PurposeThe quality of kidneys from deceased donors is critical for successful kidney transplantation. Due to donor shortages, expanded criteria donors are increasingly used, raising concerns about posttransplant outcomes. This study evaluated the predictive value of donor aortoiliac calcification on graft outcomes to improve donor assessment and transplant planning.

pmc-12653529.title: Integration of Postbiotics into Adult Diapers: In Vitro Evaluation of Biocompatibility and Effect on Skin Microbiota
pmc-12653529.creator: Oznur Ozlem Ibrahimoglu, Leyla Tarhan Celebi, Dilan Ece Dikbiyik, Halise Betul Gokce, Bekir Cakici, Zafer Türkoğlu, Ayse Nilhan Atsu, Ismail Aslan
pmc-12653529.description: Postbiotics are bioactive microbial metabolites recognized for their potential to support skin health and balance the microbiota. In this study, nonwoven fabrics and adult diaper prototypes, with and without postbiotic incorporation, were evaluated for their effects on skin microbiota, epidermal integrity, and cytotoxicity.

pmc-12823300.title: Population Pharmacokinetics of Asundexian in People at Risk for Thromboembolic/Cardiovascular Events
pmc-12823300.creator: Ashraf Yassen, Friederike Kanefendt, Jochen Zisowsky, Astrid Broeker, Hardi Mundl, Peter Vis, Dirk Garmann, Jan Berkhout
pmc-12823300.description: Asundexian is a potent, selective, and reversible inhibitor of activated clotting Factor XI currently under development for secondary prevention of recurrent ischemic stroke in the ongoing Phase III OCEANIC‐STROKE study (NCT05686070). Here, we report the development of a population pharmacokinetic (popPK) model for asundexian.

pmc-13417207.title: Effect of Center Determination Method, Point Cloud Filtering and Cross-Section Type on the Accuracy of Tree Stem Volume Estimation Using Laser Scanning
pmc-13417207.creator: Patrik Kúdela, Matej Ján Dominka
pmc-13417207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Static laser scanning is an advanced approach to timber volume estimation whose accuracy now matches or exceeds that of traditional forestry methods for volume estimation, enabling its practical application in woodworking management. This study evaluates how stem volume estimation accuracy from point clouds is affected by stem surface condition (with and without bark), cross-sectional area calculation methods, point cloud filtering, and stem center determination. Results show that the stem surface condition fundamentally controls the direction and magnitude of systematic errors.

pmc-13487949.title: Metagenomic analysis reveals resistome characteristics and high-risk resistance genes in the pig nasal cavities, feces, and farm dust
pmc-13487949.creator: Yangfan Yu, Hai Wu, Honghu Ji, Yuhan Hu, Yihuan Fang, Yuntian Lin, Yong Zhang, Yunyan Zhou

pmc-13551336.title: The Acceleration-Speed Profile in Professional Soccer Players: A Comparative Study According to Sex, the Sports Level and the Playing Position
pmc-13551336.creator: Andrés López-Sagarra, Manuel A Rodríguez-Pérez, Alexis Padrón-Cabo, Andrés Baena-Raya
pmc-13551336.description: This study aimed to compare maximum acceleration and speed capabilities in professional soccer players, both derived from the acceleration-speed (AS) profile (theoretical maximum acceleration [A0] and speed [S0]) and direct assessment (maximum acceleration [MaxAcc] and speed [MaxSpeed]), according to both (i) sex and the sports level, and (ii) the playing position.

pmc-13674189.title: Disrupted bilateral co‐ordination of soleus motor units during early subacute stroke rehabilitation
pmc-13674189.creator: Jackson T Levine, Xin S Yu, Alyssa Jones, Rebecca Muñoz, Martin Zaback, Christopher K Thompson, Dario Farina, Simon Avrillon, José L Pons
pmc-13674189.description: AbstractStroke can affect sensorimotor control, impairing balance and locomotion. These impairments increase fall risk, limit patient independence and reduce quality of life. Here, we investigated how stroke affects bilateral co‐ordination of soleus motor units during standing in individuals undergoing subacute rehabilitation. Fourteen individuals were recruited after admission for inpatient rehabilitation with sixteen age‐ and sex‐matched controls.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
